what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine living in Belgium, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8982 of these refugees in Belgium, 18.6% of all Palestinian refugees that UNHCR counts.
Greece hosts the most, followed by Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1998 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belgium.
These are year-end totals for Belgium only, reported to UNHCR.
